situation:
You are the guest communications manager at CINDERPEAK PARKS, which runs a theme park and a set of smaller attractions along a mountain corridor. The chief operating officer (judge) was hired eighteen months ago to turn the business around after two losing years. The chief operating officer (judge) has asked you to recommend how the park should price the reserved seats for its nightly arena show this summer.

The nightly show in the park's grove arena is the reason many families stay into the evening instead of leaving at dinner. Seats there are reserved and sold on top of park admission. Season pass holders buy them under a pass agreement that promises pass holders a member price on reserved show seats, and those passes are what carried the park through the two losing years.

The ticketing team has proposed dynamic pricing on the reserved show seats, moving the price up and down each week with demand. Their modeling closes most of the revenue gap the new leadership committed the board to closing this summer. Pass holders would still get a discount, but the number they see would move week to week instead of holding steady, and they would see it move on the park's own social channels.

Turning on dynamic pricing for the reserved show seats through the summer would meet the summer number, and it would put pass holders who bought on the promise of a steady member price in front of a different price every week, in the season when spring renewals are decided. Holding one posted price for the show seats and raising it once keeps that promise plain, and the summer then closes short of the gap the new leadership committed the board to closing.

The chief operating officer (judge) wants your recommendation on how the reserved show seats should be priced this summer, what the park tells guests and pass holders who write in to ask why the price moved, and what the front-line staff at the arena gate should be given to say. The chief operating officer (judge) will greet you and ask to hear your ideas, and will thank you after your presentation and questions.
